headline: Jolthog Jolt Bomb
title: Jolthog | Throwable Electric Bomb Pal | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need an early electricity worker? Meet Jolthog. Its partner skill, Jolt Bomb, lets you throw it at an enemy and it causes an Electric explosion on impact. At base it handles Generating Electricity at level one, so it can power your first generators. Do you throw Jolthog or keep it at base? Comment below!
description: Jolthog in Palworld 1.0: the Jolt Bomb partner skill and Generating Electricity level one.
